title: Whistler Jet Boating
specs: Only company permitted to operate in Nairn Falls Provincial Park
Frequent wildlife sightings including bears, deer, eagles, ospreys, and herons
Inform if guests are over 225 lbs
Minimum 4 guests required to offer tour
Participants should be in good personal health
Special offers for large groups including staff parties, stags and stagettes
includes: Tour through Nairn Falls Provincial Park and Green River Wetlands
blurb: Guests take a one-hour jet boat tour on the Green River through Nairn Falls Provincial Park, experiencing old growth forests, waterfalls, snow-capped peaks, and wildlife sightings including bears, deer, eagles, ospreys, and herons. The tour is suitable for the whole family and operates May through September, seven days a week.
extraNote: No charge if cancelled outside of 24 hours of trip departure, full charge if cancelled within 24 hours · Trips depart rain or shine · Payment by credit card (Visa or Mastercard) required to confirm booking · Sunstone Golf Club Bar & Grill clubhouse patio, 1730 Airport Road, Pemberton, BC · May through September
